Documents binding failures and offers a hypothesis about CLIP representations, but does not isolate the claimed causal mechanism.

evidence_items.explanation: The documented pipeline uses text embeddings to condition diffusion models and specifies no explicit tree-building stage. That supports the architectural premise under the explicit-parser reading, but does not establish its claimed causal consequence.

evidence_items.locator: A brief example on subject-verb number agreement
evidence_items.explanation: The author demonstrates recoverable syntactic relationships in learned BERT representations without an explicit parser in the underlying model. This cautions against inferring absence of syntactic information from architecture alone, but concerns a different system and does not prove full semantic reliability.

unresolved_gaps: No inspected experiment isolates the absence of explicit syntactic-tree derivation as the cause of the named systems' failures.
Implicit syntactic information is not equivalent to its reliable use during image generation.
The claim does not specify a finite domain over which full sensitivity could be measured.
